description: This file contains serialization and copying implementations for KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> in the Orleans framework, including codecs and deep copiers.

classes.name: KeyValuePairCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A serializer for KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> supporting encoding and decoding operations.

classes.name: KeyValuePairCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A deep copier for KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> with optional shallow copy capability.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> to the writer, including key and value fields.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> from the reader, reading key and value fields based on wire format.

methods.name: KeyValuePairCopier
methods.description: Constructor for initializing deep copier with optional key and value copiers.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Determines if the copier can perform a shallow copy when no deep copiers are provided.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of a KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue> or returns the input if shallow copying is sufficient.
